Example boxing and judo injury counts by tissue/pathology type

Source: R/tissue_df.R
tissue_df.Rd

An example dataset for plot_sunburst(): the standard injury_categories taxonomy with two columns of (fictional) injury counts attached.

Usage

tissue_df

Format

A data frame with 25 rows and 4 columns:

tissue_type

Tissue type, e.g. "Bone", "Nervous".

pathology_type

Pathology type, e.g. "Fracture", "Tendon rupture".

boxing

Number of recorded boxing injuries for that pathology.

judo

Number of recorded judo injuries for that pathology.

Details

Row order matches injury_categories, so the counts can be reused with other taxonomies built on the same ordering.

See also

injury_categories for the taxonomy without counts, plot_sunburst() to plot this dataset, and body_df for the equivalent example dataset for plot_heatmap().

Examples

plot_sunburst(tissue_df, "boxing")


plot_sunburst(tissue_df, "judo")
